_meta: editorconfig-checker enforces the file-shape contract in .editorconfig.
Language formatters own exact indentation and wrapping; this gate owns
line endings, indentation kind, final newlines, trailing space, and UTF-8.
Markdown is excluded because two trailing spaces are a hard line break -
the file itself says so. Generated and vendored bytes are somebody else's.
The `host` fixture commits a real `.zig-cache/` to exercise `--untracked`
against a tree that has one - opaque, sometimes-binary build-cache bytes,
not authored content. `tree-sitter generate` writes grammar.json and
node-types.json without the trailing newline `.editorconfig` wants, and
reformatting the CLI's own output would just be undone by its next run.
